context: Adds a bulk-update action to the admin users controller, described in the PR as a convenience for support staff managing multiple accounts at once.
explanation: The permitted params list now includes :role and :admin alongside the safe profile fields. Since user_params is shared by both update and the new bulk_update action, any authenticated admin-panel request (or a crafted form) can flip a user's role or admin flag by simply including those keys in the request body — a classic mass assignment vulnerability. Fix: keep privilege fields out of the mass-assignment allowlist and expose a separate, explicitly authorized endpoint for role changes.
